traits.name: Tail Lash
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature within reach of the dragon's tail takes an action to Strike or attempt a skill check Effect The dragon Strikes with its tail at the triggering creature at a –2 penalty. If it hits, the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the triggering roll.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (acid, arcane, evocation); The dragon breathes a spray of acid that deals 17d6 (17d6) acid damage in a 100-foot line (DC 39 basic Reflex save). It can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Corrupt Water
traits.text: ⬻ (arcane, concentrate, necromancy); Frequency once per day Effect The dragon permanently befouls 10 cubic feet of liquid within 90 feet. The liquid becomes undrinkable and unable to support water-breathing life. This destroys liquid magic or alchemical items if they're of a lower level than the dragon (a creature can attempt a DC 35 Will save to protect liquids in its possession). This doesn't affect the liquids in a creature's body.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one horns Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: The dragon recharges its Breath Weapon whenever it scores a critical hit with a Strike.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +33 (acid, magical, reach 15 feet); Damage 3d10+14 (3d10+14) piercing plus 2d6 (2d6) acid and 2d6 (2d6) persistent acid
